notablePrerequisites:
Jegantha and Sisay do not have summoning sickness.
Derevi can not be blocked.
description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for Derevi and putting it onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Jegantha.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for Samut and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Jegantha.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for Najeela and putting it onto the battlefield.
Move to your combat phase.
Declare Derevi as an attacker.
Deal combat damage to a player with Derevi, untapping Jegantha.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
AActivate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 9.
